name: forward_entity_field_to_routine
description: Passes its structure pointer to a second routine together with a word-sized value read from a fixed field inside that structure, then returns. It has no other logic, so it is a thin forwarding wrapper.

name: call_routine_when_enabled
description: Returns zero at once when a status field in the structure is zero or a global flag byte is set. Otherwise it forwards the structure to another routine, with a pointer into the global data block, and returns that routine's result.

name: forward_to_nested_routine
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns, so it is a bare forwarding stub around that call.

name: fill_handler_tables_for_entries
description: Loops over 18 entries and, for each entry whose state byte is below 2, fills a block of 15 handler slots with one routine's address, stores a fixed value and a handler in per-entry fields, and sets the state byte to 4. Afterwards it stores two more handler pointers in global slots.

name: run_state_handler_loop
description: Repeats a count-controlled loop that bumps two global counters, latches the entity state word, and calls the handler from a per-slot table when one is present. When the state has changed it calls that handler again with a flag of one, then advances the entity pointer by the value returned from another routine.

name: update_entity_state_transitions
description: Calls a routine and, when its result is negative, updates the entity state byte and state word through a branch tree that tests flags, calls routines and global counters. Otherwise it sets the state word to a terminal code and stores a timer value.

name: advance_entity_state_branches
description: Runs the same state branch tree as the transition routine, with the entity pointer taken from a register, to update the state byte, state word and global counters. In one branch it calls a routine with two stack outputs and stores a handler pointer when the returned value is below a threshold.

name: clear_entity_state_word
description: Clears the 16-bit state word in the entity structure to zero and returns.

name: handle_routine_result_state
description: Calls a routine and branches on its result. On success it bumps a counter, sets the mode word from a direction flag and may switch the state, while on failure it sets a fixed state or resets global totals and advances a global counter.

name: set_entity_failure_state
description: Sets the entity state word to a fixed failure code, marks a flag byte as full, and sets a counter to sixteen.

name: advance_entity_counter_and_mode
description: Increments an entity counter, copies a direction flag into the mode word, and when the global mode byte differs from the entity's saved mode after more than two increments it switches the state to a fixed code with a timer value of nine.

name: set_mode_and_check_switch
description: Sets the mode word to one, then if the global mode byte differs from the entity's saved mode and the counter exceeds two, it switches the state to a fixed code and sets a timer value of nine.

name: reset_entity_mode_and_poll
description: When a secondary flag is clear, it resets the counter and mode word from a direction flag, calls a routine, and clears a status byte or calls a second routine by its result. When the flag is set, it calls a routine and switches the state to a fixed code if the result is nonzero.

name: reset_mode_and_poll_status
description: Clears a counter byte and sets the mode word from a direction flag. It then calls a routine and clears a status byte when that routine returns zero, otherwise it calls a second routine.

name: set_mode_and_poll_status
description: Sets the mode word to one and calls a routine. It clears a status byte when the routine returns zero, otherwise it calls another routine.

name: clear_entity_status_byte
description: Writes zero to a single status byte in the entity structure and returns. It is a tiny reset routine called from eight places.

name: update_entity_accumulators_and_mode
description: With a nonzero second argument, it adds the entity counter into a global total, rescales the counter, and calls a routine for two outputs. It then updates two global accumulators, sets the mode word to two and calls further routines with fixed arguments; with a zero argument it only sets a state code when the mode word is zero.

name: rescale_and_accumulate_entity_values
description: Rescales an entity counter, calls a routine with two stack-allocated outputs, adds the returned values into two global accumulators, and sets the mode word to two. It then calls further routines with fixed constants.

name: set_state_when_mode_clear
description: If the entity mode word is zero, it sets the entity state word to a fixed code of nine. Otherwise it returns unchanged.

name: handle_entity_timer_and_range
description: When its second argument is zero, it counts down a timer and restores a saved state when the count reaches zero, or, if the mode word is set, calls a routine and clears a status byte or calls another routine. When the argument is nonzero, it sets mode five with a counter of eight if a stored distance is below a threshold, and otherwise switches to a fixed state code.

name: set_mode_five_and_reset
description: Sets the mode word to five, a counter byte to eight and a status byte to zero. It is a small state setup routine.

name: count_down_mode_timer
description: When the mode word is zero, it counts a timer byte down and restores the saved state when the timer reaches zero. Otherwise it calls a routine and clears a status byte or calls another routine, depending on the result.

name: poll_routine_and_clear_status
description: Calls a routine and clears a status byte when it returns zero. Otherwise it calls a second routine.

name: clear_entity_status_flag
description: Writes zero to the status byte in the entity structure and returns. It is a tiny reset routine called from four places.

name: countdown_or_set_mode_nine
description: With a zero second argument it counts a timer down while the mode word is zero and restores the saved state at zero. With a nonzero argument it sets the mode word to nine and a timer of six, or of twenty two when a stored value is at least a thousand.

name: set_entity_timer_value
description: Stores a fixed timer value of twenty two in the entity counter byte and returns.

name: countdown_timer_restore_state
description: When the mode word is zero, it decrements a timer byte and, when the timer reaches zero, restores the saved state word. Otherwise it returns unchanged.

name: advance_position_table_entry
description: Steps an index through a table of coordinate pairs held behind a pointer in the entity structure, reads the current pair and stores it scaled up into the entity position fields. It stops at a zero entry, backs up on a marker entry, mirrors the horizontal position when a side flag is set, and then sets the state word to eight.

name: update_entity_motion_state
description: With a zero second argument it runs the per-frame motion state machine, setting a global speed and speed byte on first entry and, while active, advancing a counter, deriving a direction from a flag and calling a routine when a trigger is set. With a nonzero argument it calls a routine for a target position, offsets the horizontal position and sets the state word to eight.

name: run_motion_state_branches
description: Runs the per-frame motion state branches with the entity pointer taken from a register. On first entry it sets a global speed value and a per-entity speed byte, and while active it advances a counter, derives a direction from a flag and, when a trigger is set, calls a routine, scales two global totals, adds routine results and returns the state to its restore code.

name: begin_motion_state_update
description: Initializes the entity with a speed of eight, state ten and a counter of zero, and calls a routine. It then runs the active branch, which advances a counter, derives a direction from a flag and, when a trigger is set, calls a routine and scales and accumulates two global totals before restoring the state word.

name: apply_motion_direction_trigger
description: Derives a direction from a flag once the counter is past a threshold and a global frame bit is set, then masks the direction. While the state is ten it combines the direction bits, calls a routine, scales two global totals, adds routine results to them and restores the state word from its saved value.

name: store_direction_and_trigger
description: Stores a direction byte from a register and masks it. When the state word is ten, it combines the direction bits, bumps a counter and calls a routine with scaled totals, then adds the routine results to the two global totals and restores the state word.

name: dispatch_entity_counter_state
description: When its second argument is nonzero it clears a counter and sets the state word to eight. When the argument is zero and the state is zero, it dispatches on the counter byte: at two it restores the saved state, at one it sets state two and calls a stored handler, and at zero it calls a routine, stores its result as a speed value and moves to state eight when a flag is set.

name: dispatch_counter_state_branches
description: When the state word is zero, it dispatches on the counter byte. At two it restores the saved state, at one it sets state two and calls a stored handler, and at zero it calls a routine and stores its result as a speed value, moving to state eight when a flag is set.

name: enter_state_two_with_handler
description: Sets the state word to two and the counter byte to two, then calls the handler pointer stored in the entity if one is set.

name: restore_saved_entity_state
description: Copies the saved state word into the current state word. Three callers use it to return an entity to its previous state.

name: update_entity_target_deltas
description: When a stored value is below seven hundred, it computes clamped offsets from the entity to a target position, picks a direction state and switches between two state codes depending on whether the direction matches. Otherwise it sets the state word to a fixed failure code.

name: set_direction_and_target_deltas
description: Updates the direction byte, picks a state code from whether the new and old directions match, and stores the target offsets divided by four. Each offset is clamped to a fixed limit, and a timing field is reset.

name: set_direction_and_clamp_offsets
description: Stores a direction byte from a register and chooses a state code based on whether its direction bits match the previous direction. It then recomputes the scaled horizontal and vertical offsets to a target and clamps each one to a fixed limit.

name: start_direction_offset_update
description: Chooses the state word as four or three depending on whether the new direction bits match the previous direction. It then copies the direction byte, resets a counter and a timing field, computes the scaled horizontal and vertical offsets to a target, and clamps each offset to a fixed limit.

name: reset_direction_and_clamp_offsets
description: Sets the state word to four, copies the direction byte, and resets a counter and a timing field. It then computes the scaled horizontal and vertical offsets to a target and clamps each one to a fixed limit.

name: clamp_offset_components
description: Zeroes the horizontal offset when a value passed in a register exceeds a fixed limit. It then zeroes the vertical offset if its magnitude exceeds the same limit.

name: clear_vertical_offset_over_limit
description: Zeroes the vertical offset when a value passed in a register exceeds a fixed limit.

name: update_offsets_and_notify
description: When the state word is zero, it clears a status byte and restores the saved state. Otherwise, when the status byte is clear, it computes clamped target offsets and calls a routine, and on a nonzero result it calls the stored handler and sets the status byte.

name: clamp_target_offsets_and_notify
description: When the status byte is clear, it computes the scaled target offsets and clamps each one to a fixed limit before calling a routine. On a nonzero result it calls the stored handler and sets the status byte.

name: clamp_offset_and_notify
description: Zeroes the horizontal offset when a register value exceeds a fixed limit and zeroes the vertical offset when its magnitude exceeds the same limit. It then calls a routine and, on a nonzero result, calls the stored handler and sets the status byte.

name: clear_vertical_offset_and_notify
description: Zeroes the vertical offset when a register value exceeds a fixed limit. It then calls a routine and, on a nonzero result, calls the stored handler and sets the status byte.

name: set_entity_error_state
description: Sets the entity state word to a fixed error code and returns. Five callers use it to put an entity into the same error state.

name: run_handler_and_set_mode
description: With a zero second argument it restores the saved state when the mode word is zero. Otherwise it calls the stored handler if one is set, passes a pair of global values to a routine, stores the byte result in the entity and sets the mode word to two.

name: restore_state_when_mode_clear
description: When the mode word is zero, it copies the saved state word into the current state word. Otherwise it returns unchanged.

name: choose_entity_target_response
description: Returns a routine result and, when two global flags are clear, sets the entity state from that result: a negative result leads to a target move, a state code with a stored handler or small nudges to two global totals, and other results set a fixed state. It always sets a timer value of ten at the end.

name: choose_target_response_on_negative
description: Chooses the target response when a routine returns a negative result, with the entity taken from a register. It can set a state code with a stored handler, move to a target position or nudge two global totals, and otherwise sets a failure state; a timer value of ten is always set.

name: choose_target_response_on_zero
description: Chooses the entity target response when a routine returns zero, with the entity taken from a register. It moves the entity to a target position from a pair table, selects a state code with a stored handler, or nudges two global totals by fixed steps per direction bit, and then sets a timer value of ten.

name: move_to_target_or_nudge
description: Moves the entity to a target position and sets its direction when a routine returns zero. Otherwise it selects a state code with a stored handler or nudges two global totals by fixed steps, and it always clears the counter byte and sets a timer value of ten.

name: apply_direction_or_nudge_totals
description: When a routine result is eight or four, it stores that value as the entity direction and sets a state code with a stored handler. Otherwise it calls a routine and nudges two global totals by fixed steps per direction bit; either way it clears the counter byte and sets a timer value of ten.

name: nudge_totals_and_reset_timer
description: Calls a routine, then adds or subtracts a fixed step from one global total depending on a global flag bit and another fixed step from the second total depending on the entity side flag. It then clears the counter byte and sets a timer value of ten.

name: subtract_step_from_totals
description: Subtracts a fixed step from one global total and adds or subtracts a fixed step from the other depending on the entity side flag. It then clears the counter byte and sets a timer value of ten.

name: add_step_to_global_total
description: Adds a fixed step to one global total, clears the counter byte and sets a timer value of ten.

name: move_to_pair_target_position
description: Moves the entity to a target position read from a pair table using its side flag, sets the mode word to eight, and computes the direction byte from the offsets to that position. It then calls a routine, clears the counter byte and sets a timer value of ten.

name: choose_side_target_response
description: Clears a status byte and, below a global threshold, moves the entity to a target position unless it is on the other side and a computed distance is small, in which case it counts attempts before setting a fixed state. Above the threshold it may set a state code with a stored handler or move to the target, and it always sets a timer value of ten.

name: move_to_offset_target_position
description: Stores a target position made from a global x value minus a fixed offset and the global y value. It then sets the mode word to eight and sets a timer value of ten.

name: adjust_side_target_position
description: When the entity side differs from the global side and a computed distance is small, it counts attempts and moves toward a target offset to one side, switching to a fixed state after many attempts. Otherwise it moves to a target position and sets a timer value of ten.

name: set_offset_target_and_timer
description: Sets the target position from the global x value minus a fixed offset and the global y value, sets the mode word to eight and sets a timer value of ten.

name: move_to_shifted_target_position
description: Sets the target position to a global x value shifted by a fixed smaller offset and the global y value, then sets the mode word to eight and a timer value of ten. Seven callers use it.

name: advance_timed_entity_sequence
description: With a zero second argument it counts a timer down and restores the saved state at zero. With a nonzero argument it sets mode six and a timer of thirty five, calls a routine and shifts the horizontal position, and when a global sub-counter allows and no flag blocks it, records the current position and entity pointer in global slots with a timer of seventy.

name: store_pending_entity_slot
description: When the low bits of a global counter are below eight and a global flag is clear, it saves the entity position and pointer into global slots. It then sets the entity timer to seventy and marks a global byte as six.

name: count_down_and_restore_state
description: Decrements a timer byte and, when it reaches zero, copies the saved state word into the current state word.

name: update_pair_target_approach
description: Sets the mode word to twelve. When a global flag is clear and the entity is within a side threshold, it moves toward a pair-table target offset and calls a routine, then either stores a counter and a state code chosen by a global total or takes the target from the pair table directly.

name: check_pair_range_and_approach
description: Sets the mode word to twelve. When a global flag is clear and the entity is within a range threshold indexed by a global value, it moves toward a pair-table target offset and calls a routine, then either stores a counter and a state code chosen by a global total or takes the target from the pair table directly.

name: set_state_by_threshold_value
description: Sets the mode word to twelve and the state word to fifteen when a register value is below a fixed threshold, or to fourteen otherwise.

name: enter_state_fourteen_mode
description: Sets the state word to fourteen and the mode word to twelve.

name: set_pair_target_and_mode
description: Clears a status byte, stores the pair-table target for the entity side as its target position and sets the mode word to twelve.

name: update_mode_thirteen_speed
description: With a zero second argument it returns the entity to state twelve when the mode word is eleven and clears a global flag. Otherwise it sets the mode word to thirteen, calls a routine, adds its value into a global speed total, reduces another total by a quarter and either returns early or reverses the speed and adds a fixed amount to another total.

name: reverse_speed_when_in_range
description: When a register value is below a fixed threshold and a low-bit value from a timing routine passes a test, it negates a global speed total and adds a fixed amount to another total; otherwise it calls a routine. The timing routine reads the video beam position.

name: advance_mode_eleven_state
description: When the mode word is eleven, it sets the state word to twelve and clears a global flag. Otherwise it returns unchanged.

name: run_mode_eleven_transitions
description: With a zero second argument it advances a mode eleven sequence: status two resets globals, installs handler slots for all 18 entries and moves to mode fifteen, status one moves to mode fourteen, and otherwise the state returns to twelve. With a nonzero argument it initializes mode thirteen, zeroes global totals, sets global positions from the entity and installs handler slots for the other entries.

name: set_handler_and_global_flag
description: Stores a handler pointer in the entity, sets a status byte to one, calls a routine with fixed arguments and sets a global flag to one.

name: advance_mode_eleven_transitions
description: When the mode word is eleven, it resets globals and installs handler slots for all 18 entries when the status byte is two. At status one it moves to mode fourteen, and otherwise it sets state twelve and clears a global flag.

name: reset_globals_enter_mode_fifteen
description: Clears a global field, sets another to a fixed negative value and calls a routine. It then sets a global limit, installs handler slots for all 18 entries and moves the entity to mode fifteen with a status byte of three and a stored handler.

name: enter_mode_fifteen_with_handler
description: Sets the mode word to fifteen and a status byte to three, then stores a handler pointer in a global slot.

name: return_to_state_twelve
description: Sets the state word to twelve and clears a global flag.

name: find_nearby_opposite_side_slot
description: Scans the 18 entity slots for the first eligible entry on the opposite side from the given entity that lies within a distance threshold and is not the entity itself. It returns that slot index and stores the slot pointer in a global field, or returns minus one when none qualifies or a global flag blocks the search.

name: find_next_opposite_side_slot
description: Scans forward from a starting slot index for an eligible entry on the opposite side that lies within a distance threshold. It returns the index of the first match and stores its slot pointer in a global field, or returns minus one when none is found.

name: return_no_slot_index
description: Returns minus one, the value that means no entity slot matched.

name: update_speed_from_entity_gap
description: Computes the horizontal and vertical gap between two entities and their combined distance. It sets a global speed value and a counter field from that distance, scales two global speed totals toward the gap by one of two formulas depending on a fixed threshold, and calls routines to finish the update.

name: update_speed_from_register_gap
description: Uses a horizontal and a vertical gap passed in registers to set a global speed value and a counter field from their combined distance. It scales two global speed totals toward the gap by one of two formulas depending on a fixed threshold, then calls routines to finish the update.

name: update_speed_from_gap_sum
description: Adds two register values to form a combined distance, then sets a global speed value and a counter field from it. It scales two global speed totals toward the gap by one of two formulas depending on a fixed threshold, then calls routines to finish the update.

name: scale_speed_totals_toward_gap
description: Scales two global speed totals by fractions of two gap components passed in registers, then calls routines to finish the update.

name: find_nearest_same_side_slot
description: Searches the 18 entity slots for the same-side entry nearest to the given entity. A stored horizontal range check depends on a direction flag, and the function keeps the closest candidate and returns its index, or zero when no candidate is found.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything. It is an empty stub.

name: check_opposite_side_within_range
description: Returns minus one when any entity on the opposite side lies within a distance threshold of the given entity, and zero otherwise.

name: check_opposite_side_range_register
description: Returns minus one when an entity on a side that differs from a register value lies within a distance threshold, and zero when no such entity exists. It is the register-based form of its sibling range check.

name: return_zero_result
description: Returns zero. It is a stub used where no result is needed.

name: set_speed_from_direction_bits
description: Calls two routines to start the update. With the status byte clear it reverses the horizontal speed for one side and derives the speed totals from the direction bits, and with it set it sets fixed speed totals and stores a masked routine result in the vertical total.

name: set_fixed_speed_totals
description: Sets a horizontal speed total to a fixed value that is reversed for one side and a vertical speed total to another fixed value. It then stores a masked value from a timing routine, which reads the video beam position, in the vertical total.

name: set_speed_by_direction_range
description: Calls two routines to start the update. With the status byte clear it reverses direction bits for one side and sets speed totals from them, and with it set it compares a routine result with a stored threshold before either following the direction path or setting fixed speeds.

name: set_fixed_speed_when_far
description: Compares a routine result with a stored threshold and calls a routine when it is below. Otherwise it sets fixed speed totals, reverses the horizontal one for one side and adjusts the vertical speed from a global position value.

name: set_speed_totals_from_height
description: Sets fixed horizontal and vertical speed totals and reverses the horizontal one for one side. It then adjusts the vertical speed when a global position value falls below or above fixed bounds.

name: set_speed_by_direction_offsets
description: Calls two routines to start the update. With the status byte clear it sets speed totals from fixed offsets chosen by the direction bits and side flag, and with it set it stores a side-dependent offset plus a masked routine result as the horizontal speed.

name: set_speed_offsets_from_bits
description: Sets the horizontal speed to a side-dependent offset and adds or subtracts fixed amounts according to the direction bits. It also sets a fixed vertical speed and a fixed total, and reverses the vertical speed when a global position value is below a bound.

name: set_fixed_speed_with_direction
description: Toggles the direction bits for one side and sets fixed horizontal and vertical speeds, adjusting the horizontal speed when direction bits are set. It also sets a fixed total and reverses the vertical speed when a global position value is below a bound.

name: set_speed_from_masked_result
description: Adds a side-dependent offset to a masked routine result to set the horizontal speed. It then sets a fixed total and a fixed vertical speed, which is reversed when a global position value is below a bound.

name: set_speed_from_timer_mask
description: Sets the horizontal speed from a masked timing value minus a small fixed amount, where the timing value comes from a routine that reads the video beam position. It also sets a fixed total and a fixed vertical speed, and reverses the vertical speed when a global position value is below a bound.

name: set_velocity_from_direction_vector
description: Calls routines to start the update and looks up a direction vector for the entity direction byte. It sets the horizontal and vertical speed totals to the vector components scaled up, clamps a timing total to a lower bound and adds a fixed amount to it.

name: set_velocity_from_stored_direction
description: Gets a direction vector for the entity stored direction through a routine. It sets the horizontal and vertical speed totals to the scaled components, clamps a timing total to a lower bound and adds a fixed amount to it.

name: set_speed_toward_table_target
description: Calls routines to start the update, then sets horizontal speed to a table target minus the entity position, scaled down by a shift, and sets vertical speed from a table target and timing and position values. It clamps both speeds and a timing total to fixed limits and adds an amount based on a counter.

name: record_side_status_entry
description: Stores the entity status byte in a per-side table and sets a flag when that side stored count matches the status plus an offset. The offset depends on whether the entity side matches the global side, and the entity side is recorded in a global.

name: record_status_for_side_index
description: Stores the entity status byte in a per-side table at an index passed in a register. It sets a flag when that side stored count equals the status plus nine, and records the entity side in a global.

name: clear_side_flag_entry
description: Clears a flag byte in a per-side table, using an index computed from a register, and records the entity side in a global.

name: ease_speed_toward_direction
description: Looks up a direction vector for the side byte and scales it up. When the stored direction matches or is zero it eases the speed totals toward that vector and may blend in routine values, and otherwise it doubles the vector into the speed totals.

name: ease_speed_toward_stack_vector
description: Eases both speed totals halfway toward a vector held in stack outputs. When a routine reports a valid result and the entity flag is clear, it sets the flag and blends the speed totals with a second vector and a timing value.

name: clear_entity_status_flag
description: Writes zero to the status byte in the entity structure and returns.

name: extend_speed_toward_stack_vector
description: Eases the speed totals toward a stack-output vector when the entity direction matches or is zero, and otherwise extends them to one and a half times the vector. When a routine reports a valid result and the flag is clear, it sets the flag and blends in values from a second vector and a timing routine.

name: ease_speed_toward_stack_vector
description: Eases both speed totals halfway toward a vector held in stack outputs. When a routine reports a valid result and the entity flag is clear, it sets the flag and blends the speed totals with a second vector and a timing value.

name: clear_entity_status_flag
description: Writes zero to the status byte in the entity structure and returns.

name: assign_nearest_entity_pairs
description: Chooses the two nearest entities from one side's group of nine candidates for a pairing, with distance measured by a routine. It marks the pair as active, stores their assigned entries and updates their state, counter and side fields, and then refreshes two lookup records.

name: reset_handler_tables_for_entries
description: Clears a global flag, then loops over the 18 entries. For each entry whose state byte is below two, it fills a block of handler pointers with one routine address and clears one field.

name: blit_entity_frame
description: Selects the frame for the current buffer index, claims the blitter through a jump stub and runs the drawing calls, then releases it through another jump stub. It also toggles the buffer index, optionally calls a stored handler, and updates the frame pointer and image value stored in the entity.

name: draw_sprite_list_with_blitter
description: Walks a linked list of sprite records, skips those outside the visible area and clips each remaining one, then sets the blitter mask, modulo, pointer and size registers and runs row-drawing passes. The decompiled text is cut off partway through the second pass, so the rest is not shown.

name: program_blit_row_registers
description: Computes a blit start offset from a record's fields, then writes blitter mask words, modulo values and source and destination pointers for a row pass. It loops over three source entries to set their pointers and finishes by setting the blit size.

name: initialize_sprite_record
description: Fills in a sprite record from a source descriptor, copying its frame pointer, width, height and a size field, then clears its position fields. It sets a flag byte when the extra argument is nonzero.

name: insert_record_into_list
description: When a record flag bit is set, it clears that bit, marks the record as active and links it at the head of a doubly linked list whose head pointer is passed in. It also copies a value from a per-record table into the record.

name: remove_record_from_list
description: When the record active bit is clear, it unlinks the record from the doubly linked list whose head pointer is passed in, then sets the bit to mark it as removed.

name: update_animated_record
description: Updates a record unless its removal bit is set: a custom handler or velocity integrates its position, an animation frame table advances, and the resulting position, size and frame data are copied to an output slot. When the removal bit is set, it instead writes a fixed event code into the event table.

name: reposition_record_by_key
description: Moves a record within a list ordered by a key field, searching in both directions from its current position and relinking it between the neighbours where it belongs.

name: write_sprite_output_slot
description: Writes one entry of the output buffer for a record. It stores three position values scaled down by a shift, the record flag byte, and a frame value taken from the record frame table.

name: position_record_from_frame
description: Looks up a frame entry in a per-record list by matching an id byte, falling back to the list head, and copies its dimensions and offsets into the record. It sets the vertical position with one of two formulas depending on whether the slot index is below a threshold, then runs the list update.

name: tally_side_counts_and_start
description: Reads two side values from global state and loops five times, incrementing a per-side counter when a routine returns one and installing a callback on each pass. It then repeats while the two side counters are equal and starts a routine with fixed timing values.

name: initialize_display_and_run_loop
description: Sets per-side colour and position values, initializes nine entity slots and writes the DMA control register to enable DMA channels, then runs a loop that updates a frame counter and uses graphics stubs to set a pen and fill a rectangle. The decompiled text is cut off partway through the loop, so the end of the routine is not shown.

name: select_frame_for_state
description: Chooses an animation state for an entity slot from a routine result and the side it belongs to, unless a status byte is already set. It then writes that state's frame values, a stored position pair and a status byte, and returns the state's second value.

name: set_default_frame_values
description: Sets the state word to twelve and a second value to zero, writes two fixed frame values into the global frame table, and stores the state in two frame fields and a status byte. It returns the second value.

name: set_default_frame_values
description: Sets the state word to twelve and a second value to zero, writes two fixed frame values into the global frame table, and stores the state in two frame fields and a status byte. It returns the second value.

name: shrink_packed_nibble_values
description: Splits a 16-bit packed value into a high byte and two nibbles, reduces each field by two with a floor at zero, and repacks the results into the same value.

name: run_fifty_step_update_loop
description: Sets starting values in a group of global position and frame fields, then runs a fifty step loop. Each pass updates two counters and four table entries, refreshes nine slot entries through a routine, and calls a routine with a fixed value during the first two passes.

name: allocate_display_structures
description: Allocates view, viewport and raster port structures, colour lists and bitmap or raster buffers for one or two buffers, using jump stubs to initialize each graphics structure. It returns minus one if any allocation or setup step fails and zero on success.

name: free_display_structures
description: Releases the display structures created for one or two buffers, freeing their colour map, viewport copper lists and copper list entries through jump stubs.

name: allocate_raster_buffers
description: Initializes a bitmap structure, then allocates the requested number of raster buffers and stores each pointer in the structure. It returns zero when all buffers are allocated and minus one if an allocation fails.

name: free_raster_buffers
description: Frees each raster buffer in the structure using its stored width and height, then clears its pointer slots.

name: switch_active_display_buffer
description: Makes the buffer selected by a stored index the active one by pointing the view and colour-list fields at its entries. It clears one buffer field and calls routines to refresh the display setup.

name: parse_iff_style_chunks
description: Reads tagged chunks from a file in a loop and dispatches on each four-character tag: DELT unpacks run-length delta data, CMAP converts three-byte colour entries to 16-bit words, and BMHD reads a 20-byte header. Other chunks are skipped, and the routine returns one when the file cannot be opened and zero otherwise.

name: reset_index_range_and_call
description: Sets a start and an end counter to 256 and 257, then calls a routine with a zero argument. It is a small setup step before buffered reads.

name: read_buffered_bytes
description: Copies up to a requested number of bytes from an internal 256-byte buffer into the caller output, refilling the buffer through a routine when it runs out. It returns the number of bytes copied.

name: call_load_rgb4_stub
description: Calls the graphics library routine that loads RGB colour values, by jumping through its library vector. It takes no arguments of its own.

name: call_wait_for_frame_stub
description: Calls the graphics library routine that waits for the top of the next display frame, through its library vector.

name: call_make_viewport_stub
description: Calls the graphics library routine that builds a viewport, through its library vector.

name: call_merge_copper_lists_stub
description: Calls the graphics library routine that merges copper lists, through its library vector.

name: call_load_view_stub
description: Calls the graphics library routine that loads a view, through its library vector.

name: free_bucket_lists
description: Walks 71 bucket lists of linked entries and, when the second argument is nonzero, frees each entry and clears each bucket head. It finishes by calling a routine with the structure and the argument.

name: set_record_flag_bytes
description: When the record pointer is set, it stores a nonnegative second argument and a nonnegative third argument into two byte fields of the record. It returns the last value stored.

name: allocate_record_if_missing
description: When a record pointer is missing, it allocates a new record and, when a flag bit is set, one or two extra blocks whose pointers it stores in the record. It then copies two byte fields from the parent descriptor into the new record.

name: free_record_if_present
description: When a record pointer is set, it frees the record optional blocks through a routine, releases the record itself, and clears the pointer.

name: build_records_from_count
description: Gets a count from a routine and returns one if it is below one. Otherwise it clears a total field, runs a routine once for each requested item, then runs two finishing routines and returns zero.

name: load_records_from_stream
description: Reads records from a stream until the FINE tag appears, allocating a record for each and filling its position, size, depth and frame fields. When a flag bit is set it prepares blitter registers and writes frame words, optional data behind a DATI tag is read into a new buffer, and the record list is stored in the parent structure.

name: copy_record_buckets
description: Copies 71 bucket list heads from one structure to another, copies a head field, and sets a flag byte and bit in the destination. It then calls a routine with the remaining two arguments.

name: load_bitmap_records_from_stream
description: Reads records from a stream until the FINE tag appears, allocating a record for each and initializing a bitmap and raster buffer from the record dimensions through jump stubs. It stores the record pointers in the caller array and returns zero on success or one when a step fails.

name: free_pointer_list_entries
description: Walks a zero-terminated array of pointers, passing each entry to a routine with a value from the owner structure, freeing it with a fixed size and clearing its slot.

name: read_joystick_and_mouse_ports
description: Shifts the previous four state bytes along, then decodes the joystick and mouse port data registers and the fire button register into direction and button state for each port. It finally clears any direction value outside the valid set.

name: wait_for_blitter_idle
description: Polls the DMA control read register until the blitter busy flag clears, then returns.

name: poll_blitter_busy_register
description: Polls a hardware status register through an address register until the blitter busy flag clears, then returns.

name: decode_blitter_command_list
description: Walks a list of two-byte command pairs, using the first byte to choose one of three modes that store a blitter setting and line count into a per-blit record, and for the data-carrying mode it also records the source address and advances past the data. It clears the blitter modulo register first.

name: tick_dma_channel_countdowns
description: Calls an optional callback, then ticks four countdown counters. When each counter reaches zero, it writes its channel bit into a global flag word and clears the counter.

name: store_base_pointer_global
description: Stores the current base register value into a global variable slot.

name: build_audio_sample_pointers
description: Walks a table of byte-coded entries to find a boundary, then fills 30 pointer slots with offsets derived from a size field. It clears the channel pointer block and three audio state values, and sets the current volume register value from a stored byte.

name: update_audio_channel_playback
description: Runs once per frame to advance the audio channels: on every sixth tick it selects the next sample position, updates the channel location registers, enables the channels and wraps the sample index, and on other ticks it applies volume or period changes from each channel effect code.

name: apply_audio_channel_effect
description: Applies the current effect code to one audio channel. Codes one and two slide the period down or up and clamp it, code ten adjusts the volume up or down by a nibble amount, and other codes look up a period value from a table.

name: parse_audio_track_command
description: Reads one audio track entry, selects its sample pointer and length from a table, and stores the channel state. It then decodes the entry command nibble, which toggles a flag, sets a volume, changes a control flag or sets a track position.

name: allocate_block_with_header
description: Calls a routine to get a size and returns null when it is below one. Otherwise it allocates a block with a two-field header, copies the requested data into it and stores the requested value in the header, returning null if the allocation fails.

name: process_block_if_nonempty
description: When the block pointer is set and its first field is nonzero, it passes the block and an offset from that field to a routine. It returns the block pointer unchanged.

name: install_interrupt_server
description: Allocates an interrupt node, fills in its type, priority, name and handler fields, and registers it with the system interrupt server list through a jump stub.

name: set_audio_request_pointer
description: When the first value of its argument is nonzero, it stores a pointer to the following data in a global slot, calls a routine, and sets a flag to one.

name: stop_audio_and_clear_flag
description: Clears a global flag, then calls a routine that silences the four audio channels and clears their DMA enable bits.

name: set_audio_channel_word
description: Stores a 16-bit value in a per-channel slot of the audio channel table, where the channel index is the first argument.

name: set_audio_channel_period
description: Gets a value from a routine and writes it to the period register of the audio channel named by the argument.

name: start_audio_channel_sample
description: Starts playback on one audio channel. It stores the sample pointer and length for the channel, sets its period through a routine, and enables that channel DMA bit in the DMA control register.

name: mark_audio_channel_active
description: Sets the per-channel flag for the given channel to one.

name: call_free_memory_stub
description: Calls the system FreeMem routine through its library vector, passing on the arguments already in place.

name: call_allocate_memory_stub
description: Calls the system AllocMem routine through its library vector, passing on the arguments already in place.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything. It is an empty stub.

name: play_audio_entry_if_found
description: Looks up an entry through a routine and returns minus one if it is missing. When the entry has a flag bit set it calls a reset routine, then passes the entry data to another routine and returns minus one when a global status value is set.

name: parse_args_and_open_console
description: Splits a command-line string into up to 32 arguments, treating double-quoted text as one argument, and fetches the DOS input and output handles and the current task. It then sets up a console window from a fixed console specification string, using a default handle when no arguments are given.

name: setup_display_objects
description: Creates an object through a routine, then calls setup routines that configure its size, frame, and display position values. It finishes by storing two fixed positional values in the object and calling a final routine.

name: release_active_handle_entries
description: Walks the handle table from its last index downward and, for each active entry without a flag bit set, calls a routine on the stored value. It then calls a routine with the argument.

name: shutdown_io_and_callbacks
description: Runs an optional callback, then calls library routines to shut down the input and output state. When a device pointer is set, it closes that device through library routines and returns its argument.

name: append_bounded_string
description: Appends up to a limit of characters from the source string to the end of the destination string, writes a terminating zero, and returns the destination.

name: calculate_string_length
description: Returns the number of bytes before the zero terminator of a byte string, by scanning forward from the start pointer and taking the distance to the terminator.

name: call_entry_routine_or_fail
description: Looks up an entry through a routine and returns minus one when it is missing. Otherwise it calls a routine with the entry stored pointer and the two arguments, and returns minus one when a global error code is set.

name: open_handle_in_free_slot
description: Finds the first free slot in the handle table from index three upward, converts the access bits into a mode value and opens a file for it, retrying with an alternate mode if the first open fails. It stores the handle and descriptor in the slot and returns the slot index, or minus one with an error code set when no slot is free or the mode is invalid.

name: free_linked_node_list
description: Walks a singly linked list of nodes, releasing each node through the system memory free routine. It then clears the list head and its count field and returns zero.

name: call_entry_routine_or_fail
description: Looks up an entry through a routine and returns minus one when it is missing. Otherwise it calls a routine with the entry stored pointer and the two arguments, and returns minus one when a global error code is set.

name: process_pending_entry_buffers
description: Walks a list of entries and, for each one that is active, writable and has unsent data, calls a routine to write the pending bytes from its buffer. It finishes by calling a routine with the argument.

name: write_bytes_and_record_error
description: Clears the last error code, runs an optional flush routine, then calls the DOS write routine. When the write fails, it records the DOS error code and returns the result.

name: seek_file_position
description: Clears the error code, optionally runs a flush routine, and seeks in the open file through the DOS seek routine. It records the DOS error code when seeking fails, then returns a position computed from the origin argument.

name: read_bytes_and_record_error
description: Clears the last error code, optionally runs a flush routine, then calls the DOS read routine. On failure it records the DOS error code and sets an error status, and returns the read result.

name: open_file_or_record_error
description: Clears the last error code, optionally runs a flush routine, then opens a file through the DOS open routine. On failure it records the DOS error code, sets an error status and returns minus one.

name: probe_file_lock_or_open
description: Clears the last error code, optionally runs a flush routine, then tries to lock the file: a successful lock is released and the routine returns minus one. A failed lock falls back to opening the file, and when that also fails it records the DOS error code and sets an error status.

name: delete_existing_file_then_open
description: Clears the last error code, optionally runs a flush routine, then locks the file, releasing a successful lock and deleting the file before the open routine is called. A failed open records the DOS error code, sets an error status and returns minus one.

name: close_file_after_flush
description: Runs an optional flush routine, closes the open file through the DOS close routine and returns zero.

name: compute_fixed_point_product
description: Multiplies two 32-bit fixed-point values from registers and returns the product in the same fixed-point format. It combines the high and low halves of both inputs, forming the cross terms and the low-by-low product.

name: divide_fixed_point_values
description: Divides one 32-bit fixed-point value by another, handling signs separately, and returns the quotient in the same format. It normalizes the divisor by shifting, runs a long division on the high bits, and corrects the remainder before returning.
